al.title: Set up Altium
al.intro: Done once by a librarian. The resulting .DbLib file goes in the share and is then used by the whole team.
al.s1: On each PC: install the 64-bit PostgreSQL ODBC driver (psqlODBC, “PostgreSQL Unicode(x64)” driver).
al.s2: In Altium: File » New » Library » Database Library.
al.s4: In Options, set the double quote (") as left and right quote character.
al.s5: For each table, choose “Part Number” as the key field. Altium recognises Library Ref, Library Path, Footprint Ref and Footprint Path on its own.
al.s6: In Symbol & Model Search Path, enter {share} with sub-folder search. Save the .DbLib and upload it below: it goes to the root of the share, and each PC adds it from there.
al.noRo: The read-only account password is not set (ALTIUM_RO_PASSWORD in .env).
